strongest_angle: Procore's Magpie 3.0 construction AI engine scored 78% on a benchmark of over 200 real-world construction tasks, outperforming general frontier AI models by 18 percentage points according to company announcements at Groundbreak 2026.

key_facts.fact: Procore announced that its Magpie 3.0 reasoning engine completed 78 percent of over 200 real-world construction tasks during the Groundbreak 2026 preview.
Procore Technologies reported that Magpie 3.0 scored 18 points above the closest general-purpose frontier model on construction-specific tasks.
The benchmark for Magpie 3.0 evaluated over 200 real-world tasks encompassing questions from superintendents, project managers, and project executives about drawings, RFIs, submittals, and schedules.
Miles Gordenker noted on LinkedIn that Procore Technologies outperformed general AI models in construction benchmarks with the Magpie engine.
